descriptionFull: The bullfinch , common bullfinch or Eurasian bullfinch ( Pyrrhula pyrrhula ) is a small passerine bird in the finch family Fringillidae. In Anglophone Europe it is known simply as bullfinch , as it is the original bird to bear the name bullfinch.
